announcements.headline: EQS-News: Zalando grows profitably in Q3, driven by very strong B2B expansion, and continues innovating through AI with Zalando Extended
announcements.insight: Zalando's profitable growth signals a successful pivot from pure e-commerce to a tech-enabled platform, with B2B expansion serving as a critical new revenue stream amidst broader European retail headwinds.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Zalando delivers another quarter of profitable growth in Q2, accelerates B2B expansion and continues innovating through AI
announcements.insight: Sustained profitable growth in the e-commerce sector signals operational resilience amid macro headwinds, while the B2B pivot and AI integration highlight a strategic shift toward higher-margin, scalable revenue streams distinct from traditional consumer retail.
